text: The Pro plan costs $99 per month and includes unlimited API calls.
Annual billing on the Pro plan saves 20% compared to monthly.
Enterprise pricing is custom; contact sales for a quote.
The Free tier supports up to 100 API calls per day.
Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days within the US.
International shipping is 10-21 business days.
Express shipping is 1-2 days for an additional $15.
We do not ship to PO Boxes.
We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee on hardware products.
Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after return.
Software subscription refunds are pro-rated within the first 7 days.
Items damaged in shipping are replaced or refunded at no cost.
To cancel, navigate to Account Settings > Billing > Cancel.
Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period.
There are no early-termination fees on annual plans.
After cancellation, your data is retained for 30 days then permanently deleted.
We support 32 languages including English, Spanish, French, and German.
Customer support is available in 12 languages 24/7.
The mobile app supports auto-translation between supported languages.
Documentation is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Japanese.
Two-factor authentication is required for all enterprise accounts.
API keys can be rotated from Account Settings > API Keys.
We use AES-256 encryption for all data at rest.
SSO via SAML 2.0 is available on the Enterprise plan.
Mobile app version 5.4 or later is required.
iOS support requires iOS 16 or later.
Android support requires Android 11 or later.
API rate limits are 1000 requests per minute by default.
Webhooks support HMAC-SHA256 signatures for verification.
Our SDK is available for Python, Node.js, Ruby, Go, and Java.
Trial period is 14 days, no credit card required.
Educational discounts of 50% are available for verified students.
Non-profit pricing is available — apply via the partnerships page.
Same-day shipping is not currently offered.
Tracking links are emailed once the package is dispatched.
Cancelled subscriptions can be reactivated within 60 days.
Bulk refunds for enterprise accounts are processed monthly.
Refunds for digital goods are evaluated case by case.
Right-to-left language support includes Arabic and Hebrew.
Mandarin Chinese is supported in both simplified and traditional scripts.
Compliance certifications include SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA.
Single-tenant deployments are available on the Enterprise plan.
Audit logs are retained for 90 days; longer on request.
GraphQL endpoint is available at api.foolwidget.com/v2.
Browser support: latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge.
We do not support Internet Explorer.
Custom domains require a CNAME record pointing to cnames.foolwidget.com.
Bulk import via CSV is available from Account Settings > Import.
Data export is available as JSON or Parquet from Account Settings > Export.
Webhook retries are exponential up to 5 attempts over 24 hours.
